newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus 91-day t-bill yield rises to 6.035 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus 91-day t-bill yield rises to 6.035 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus said it sold 5.0 million pounds ($10.82 million) of 91-day treasury bills at an average yield of 6.035 percent compared to 5.990 percent at the previous auction on November 13.
The bank offered 15 million pounds of bills and received competitive bids totalling 7.0 million. There were no non-competitive bids.
The lowest accepted yield was 6.016 percent and the highest 6.048 percent.
Treasury bill auctions are held on the second and fourth Wednesday of every month. ($=0.46 pounds)
